verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents mobile receipt/memo capture and automated emails chasing missing receipts/memos, plus expense management tracking, which addresses part of the story, but this is manual upload via app, not automatic capture at time of card use, and no evidence of automatic coding/categorization at the moment of swipe. Missing for 10: automatic (non-manual) receipt capture triggered by card transaction, automated categorization/coding logic, and any hands-on proof of real-time capture without user action.
